top_posts.author: AdamBrennan2
top_posts.text:
look where coca cola $KO sent its cash over the last 10 years, most of it went out as dividends 
 
only a small slice was reinvested in the business, but the capital it does keep earns well above its cost, and the newest money earns even more 
 
to me this looks like a mature brand that hands back nearly all its cash and still reinvests sensibly, but a payout that big leaves little room for error
